trophies.guide: The platinum. It pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Expect roughly 200 hours for the full road: story, the 100% checklist, the stranger strands and the clean-up. Keep one manual save at the start of every chapter so a missed step never costs a whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. Everything counts in full: all robberies including 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations, every underwater discovery, gold in every Shooting Range challenge, all drone races, and Bret's 15 Target Decks. The partial targets are 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Track it under Progress in the pause menu and save the grind for after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission. Before you start it, make a manual save — there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so this is the last easy point to go back and clean up anything left. The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida (130 jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps). Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. The map shows every Stunt Spot and Progress > Activities > Stunts keeps the count; 100% completion wants 300.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Work range by range and replay the challenges you miss — nothing here is missable, so take your time and learn each range's targets before chasing the gold time or score.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away clean. Vaults open up through the optional Chapter 4 mission about where the money is: follow a security van to its bank, and remember the haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Expect 4 stars every time and up to $205,000 per vault; Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 if you want the next target marked.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count toward it; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. Which other strands qualify is still being confirmed, so watch the in-game trophy progress counter as you finish each one. One warning: Yago's race in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive — do it the moment its hourglass icon appears, and save first.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so sweep each region as the story takes you there rather than leaving the hunt to the end. Track the sets under Progress > Collections so you can see which set is one card short.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK it at 100 locations. Hold Up on the D-pad, then R1/RB to scan. The full WAiNK set is 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures plus No Flusher tags, so 100 is reachable well before you finish the set. Scan whenever you pass a marked spot — it adds up fast and also feeds the vehicle and animal counts.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Gone Fishing. It is unmissable on the story path — just play through it and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Chapter trophies sometimes pop at the boundary — this one lands when Chapter 2 begins. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude): it may be the only missable spot in the game.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. The name is censored as T**s in the published lists, and this guide keeps it as published. It pops after the Welcome to Vice City mission, at the start of Chapter 3. Make a manual save at the chapter start — you get 15 manual slots plus one autosave, so keep one per chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. It pops after the Ocean Beach and Another Life missions, at the start of Chapter 4. Chapter 3 is where several side strands open up — Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Randy's Key Cloner mission, Andy's first text — so sweep the new contacts before moving on.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Unmissable on the story path; the trophy pops at the chapter boundary. Chapter 4 is also when the optional bank-vault mission opens — follow a security van, split the haul with your partner, and bank the first vault toward Maximum Withdrawal.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is on the main story path and cannot be missed — play through it and the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy on the main path — finish the heist and it pops. Save before the big story heists anyway; a manual save at each chapter start is the cheapest insurance in the game.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable — it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Unmissable on the main path; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable. While you are at the airport, note the layout — the Catch Me If You Can trophy needs a passenger jet taken from a departure gate here, and knowing where gates E3/E4 are saves time later.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable on the main path; the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand. It is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 when he texts her an address in Belville. Five missions in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, then Puff Puff Pass. The trophy pops after the last one. Andy does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but his finale has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand: 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig up the treasure. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so don't worry if he goes quiet — track progress under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand: 5 jobs at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, available after the Coffee Break mission in Chapter 2. The 5th job, Hometown Heroes, awards the trophy, and the strand stays available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand: his Wish List. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver 16 sports cars to his garage in west Vice City; scan cars with WAiNK to check whether they are on the list. Hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best hunting ground, and better condition pays more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand. Jason-only: after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City, then play Shut Down the Labs. The trophy pops after the finale. Tyrone does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when he texts Jason; the first hunt is Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks and bring them back as Jason — a clean one-shot kill pays more, but it is not required. Which animal triggers this trophy is not confirmed yet, and 100% completion needs all 15 Target Decks, so work the decks and it will come.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, a race challenge or a Top Fun drone race), and a stunt. Most of these come naturally while chasing other trophies — the list here doubles as a sampler of everything Leonida offers.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy; 100% completion wants all 42 races. Learn each course's gates on a first run, then push for the win — the drone handles like nothing else in the game, so expect a few practice laps.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. The same race twice does not count, so keep moving to new events — car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all feed the count. Check the race menu for events you have not won yet.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot. Play through his fishing quests and then beat him in his challenge — steady reeling and watching the line tension matters more than speed.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Three games sit on the TV at home — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — and Bang For Your Buck runs on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick any one and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total, tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE MISSABLE WARNING: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1, on the morning after Down to Earth, disappears after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether that spot is required — so do it before Chapter 1 ends. Meditating with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, and the last spot needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick, so work down the list and pick the easy ones first — many complete themselves while you play. 100% completion wants 70, so you will likely pass 50 on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. You need both characters together, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so start one, then break line of sight — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters nicely. The trophy pops once the heat is fully gone.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City are close together — they open up after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. Hit all three in a row; it can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop, and if it doesn't, rob a 4th. Keep the wanted level alive between shops and don't let it drop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK — you don't need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan everything that passes; 100 comes quickly. This also feeds the 200-of-277 vehicle scans that 100% completion wants.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is clicking both sticks while aiming — fill Focus first (eat, drink and wash up at home; Adrenaline extends it), then use an assault rifle against a group. Gang operation thugs count; cops, soldiers and civilians don't seem to. A gang operation with clustered enemies is the best setup.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 and use it on the locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Find the note with the safe code in the back room. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well for this.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Box it in so it can't move, then use a sticky bomb on the back doors — or note that a bank vault robbery plus escape also counts toward this one. Grab the cash and break away before the response builds up.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map. The quickest way is by plane: fly a grid over the state and watch the fog peel back. Do it late in the game when you have fast aircraft and free time, and it doubles as a sightseeing tour of the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs, shown as yellow map icons. Progress > Gangs keeps the count. 100% completion needs all 39 operations, so this trophy comes on the way to the full sweep; do one per gang first to pop it early.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. The Credit Check mission (Meet Raul's Crew, Chapter 3) gets you the Dye Pack Jammer; after that, rob banks and bank vaults and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so every sale counts toward the $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — a running total. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it, and by the time you have bought the garages and kitted out a few cars you will be most of the way there. It counts every shop in the game, so just play and spend.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate phone app, after the Daily Driver mission in Chapter 2, for about $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages don't count — only the 8 you buy. Save up during the story and buy them in one sweep once the app is open.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the app; take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray and register them. At first only cars without trackers can be registered; from Chapter 3 any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones too. You need free garage space and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA airport: steal a big passenger jet docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield don't count. Gates E3/E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge. Get about 1 km away and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank. Head to Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — tanks sit at the south end of the base. Expect heavy resistance on the way in; grab the tank and drive it out to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down. The official description says to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — the exact trigger has not been confirmed by the sources yet, so this guide won't invent a method. Best reading: head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail, and see if it pops; check back here as the community pins it down.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down. The official description points at smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, but the exact showroom and trigger have not been confirmed yet. Best reading: drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front and out the other side. This guide will not invent a step — it will be updated when the method is confirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. It is a gang operation site, first marked by the Hit Kingpin Bowling job in Chapter 2. Three valuables are inside: a luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a northeast table, and a safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You don't need all three valuables in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so grab what you can.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia. Check the pause menu under Jason & Lucia > Strength, then work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along — training one trains the other too. After the story, you can train at home. The trophy pops when both characters hit max Strength.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Reach 500 Criminal Profile actions. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI to watch the count climb. Most players get this without trying — but a warning: pushing toward an irredeemable criminal profile is permanent, so don't grind crimes you don't need just for this counter.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down. The official description — 'Second time's the charm' — suggests retrying something after a first failure, but no source has confirmed the exact trigger yet. This guide won't invent a method; the honest advice is to play normally and watch for it, and to check back once the community pins it down.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down. The official description — 'What the hell just happened?' — reads like a surprise event or an odd accident, but the exact trigger has not been confirmed by any source yet. This guide won't invent a method; keep playing, keep an eye out for strange events around Leonida, and check back once the trigger is pinned down.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet pinned down. The official description points at a melee drive-by that bowls someone over — the exact setup has not been confirmed yet. Best reading: strike a pedestrian with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. This guide won't invent a method; it will be updated when the community confirms the trigger.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
